name: The Defense of Grom'gol
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
When we first arrived in this jungle we did not intend to wage war on the local tribes.  Our mission to supply Stonard is of the highest priority.  But complications have arisen.  A local band of ogres has occupied the Mizjah Ruins to the southeast of Grom'gol.  Despite warnings, they continue to ambush our supply caravans.

I am putting you in charge of dealing with these uncooperative ogres.

Travel to the ruins and attempt to drive them from the area.  At the very least it will send a firm message.
narrative.objectives: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill 10 Ogre Brutes and 5 Ogre Witch Doctors.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done. You have served the Warchief with honor.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you made any progress with the ogres of the Mizjah Ruins yet, Champion?
